reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share some significant improvements in our water mechanics! With the latest update, water depth now operates more efficiently, allowing for smoother gameplay. You can raise lips, dig ditches, and turn wells without freezing the frame. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water Mechanics Update in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to announce a major update to our water mechanics! With native sparse flow, you can now shape the terrain without freezing the frame. This enhancement ensures that water depth and flow are more responsive, making your city-building experience even better. Read all about it here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
